# Feature request

## Problem
What matchmaking or diagnostics problem should this solve?

## Proposal
What should the app do? Which tab does it belong to
(Monitor / Modes / Servers / Overlay / Rivals / Gamepad / Settings)?

## Honesty check
Does the proposal need ping/region data? If so, how should the app behave
when the host does not answer (unreachable = `-1` / "no response", never
invented values)?

## Firewall impact
Does it need new `ETK-*` firewall rules? Are they reversible in one click
with cleanup on exit?

## Notes
Anything else (mockups, examples, references).
